import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score
import json
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_parquet('/scratch/ziv_baretto/llmserve/final_code/conversational/output/stage3b_data_prep/prepared_PLAN-TSK-1967.parquet')

# Split data
train_df, temp_df = train_test_split(df, test_size=0.3, random_state=42)
val_df, test_df = train_test_split(temp_df, test_size=0.5, random_state=42)

# Train: Logistic Regression
X_train = train_df.drop('output', axis=1)
y_train = train_df['output']
model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000).fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict
X_test = test_df.drop('output', axis=1)
y_true = test_df['output']
y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Calculate metrics
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)
precision = precision_score(y_true, y_pred)
recall = recall_score(y_true, y_pred)
f1 = f1_score(y_true, y_pred)

print(json.dumps({
    'accuracy': float(accuracy),
    'precision': float(precision),
    'recall': float(recall),
    'f1': float(f1)
}))
